subject: Redwood private deployment: pricing, bundling & warranty questions
messages:
From: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@blueskyhealth.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@blueskyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private deployment: pricing/packaging questions + warranty

Hi David,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We're kicking off the vendor evaluation for a private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) and I have a few concrete pricing and packaging questions to help our procurement team:

- How is the platform fee typically amortized for a 12 vs 24 month commit?
- Can you share a clear mapping of support tiers (response targets, included hours, oncall/pricing)?
- Do you offer implementation/migration credits for pilots that convert to production?
- What's Redwood's standard warranty/remediation SLA and the structure for service credits?

Our rough footprint for the pilot is ~4 GPU nodes; production could be 8–12 nodes. We'd like a term sheet and SOW we can share with procurement (procurement@blueskyhealth.com).

Can you attach a sample term sheet and a support matrix? Also, any examples of staggered discount schedules or amortization tables would be helpful.

Looking to schedule a short call this week if needed.

Best,
Samir
Samir Joshi
Head of Procurement, BlueSky Health
samir.joshi@blueskyhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

---
Attachments: purchasing-guidelines.pdf (sent separately by procurement)
From: david.kim@redwood.com <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@blueskyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment: pricing/packaging questions + warranty

Samir — thanks for the clear list. I attached a draft term sheet and an initial SOW to give you numbers and packaging to review: redwood-privdeploy-term-sheet-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx. Quick answers up front and a few configurable options below.

Short answers:
- Platform fee amortization: typically amortized monthly over the committed term (12/24/36 mo). We can invoice upfront or quarterly if needed for accounting.
- Support tiers: Bronze (email, 24 business-hour response), Silver (business hours, 4-hr P1), Gold (24/7, 1-hr P1 + SRE retainer).
- Implementation credit: we offer a one‑time migration credit for pilots that convert to production (can be applied against first 6 months of platform fee).
- Warranty/SLA credits: standard 72‑hour remediation target for P1 with service credits on missed SLAs; extended SLA windows available on Gold.

Pricing examples (ballpark, see term sheet):
- Platform fee (baseline): $120,000 / year (amortized pro rata), can be discounted with term commitment.
- Node license: $8,000 / GPU-node / month (support included depends on tier).
- Discounts: baseline 10% at 12mo commit, 18% at 24mo, 25% at $1.2M+ ARR.
- Pilot migration credit: standard $30,000 credit for pilots converting to committed production within 90 days.

Options we propose to present:
1) Pilot -> Production: 3mo pilot (no platform fee), convert with $30k migration credit applied to first invoice.
2) 12mo commit: platform fee amortized monthly; 10% discount on node licenses.
3) 24mo commit: 18% discount + option to amortize platform fee over 24 months with monthly invoices or annual invoice at renewal.

I'll set up a 30min slot Thursday to walk through the term sheet. Marissa/Naomi can pick up the detailed commercial tradeoffs if we need to counter.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-privdeploy-term-sheet-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@blueskyhealth.com>, david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment: pricing/packaging questions + warranty

Samir — adding the packaging detail below so procurement has concrete line items. I also attached our support matrix (privdeploy-support-matrix.xlsx).

Packaging candidates (pick one for a formal quote):
- Starter Pilot (3 months): No platform fee, node license at list less 5%, Bronze support. Migration credit applies on conversion.
- Production Standard (12 mo): Platform fee $120k/year amortized, node license $8k/node/mo, Silver support included for first 3 months (ramp). 10% node discount.
- Production Preferred (24 mo): Platform fee $120k/year amortized; node license $8k/node/mo less 18%; Gold support optional at $15k/mo SRE retainer. Implementation credit $30k.

Support tier summary (excerpt):
- Bronze: Email triage, response within 24 business hours, no oncall.
- Silver: Business hours coverage (M-F 8-6), 4-hr P1 response, 4 SRE hours/month included.
- Gold: 24/7 coverage, 1-hr P1 response, dedicated SRE hours, quarterly performance reviews.

Finance and PO notes:
- We can accept net30 or net45 depending on procurement policy; for annual upfront invoicing we can take net60 with purchase order.
- Platform fee amortization schedule can be adapted to match BlueSky's accounting rules (monthly amortization vs upfront prepaid).

If BlueSky expects a strong probability of 24mo conversion, we can add an additional 2% discount and discuss an extended migration credit (up to 6 months) in exchange for earlier signature.

-Marissa
Senior Commercial Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment: pricing/packaging questions + warranty

Thanks Samir — quick commercial counter-proposal from our side that tends to meet procurement halfway: 

Proposal (alternative):
- 18-month committed term (midpoint between 12/24)
- Platform fee: standard level, 15% discount applied to platform fee if invoiced annually; otherwise amortized monthly with 10% discount.
- Node licenses: 15% discount off list for the 18mo term.
- Implementation credit: $45,000 if pilot converts to production within 120 days.
- Warranty: extend remediation target consideration to 90 days for initial ramp; service credits escalate on repeat misses.

Additional concessions (if BlueSky agrees to a signed SOW within 30 days):
- One-time waiver of onboarding fee (up to $25k)
- Priority scheduling for migration window (we reserve dedicated engineering slots)

Please note we need a procurement PO or DocuSign-ready term sheet so we can route this through Legal/Rev for approval. If procurement requires a specific PO template, please send it to procurement@redwood.com and we will make sure finance aligns.

-Naomi
VP, Customer Success & Commercial Operations
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
From: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@blueskyhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment: pricing/packaging questions + warranty

Naomi/Team — appreciate the flexibility and the concrete alternative. A couple of notes from procurement:

- BlueSky's preference is still leaning toward a 24-month term for budget predictability; the 18mo proposal is interesting but we'd need a stronger migration credit (looking for $60k) or a 20% node discount to justify not committing 24mo.
- PO process: procurement will raise a standard PO once we have a final term sheet. I attached our purchasing-guidelines.pdf for your finance team.
- DocuSign: can you create a DocuSign-ready term sheet we can circulate? procurement@blueskyhealth.com will be the signer group.

We can do a call Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT to finalize commercial points. If that works, please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Samir

2) Attach a final support matrix and the SOW draft for procurement review.
3) Naomi/Marissa will have final concession language on onboarding fees and amortization schedule.
4) Karthik will join the call for technical questions around node sizing and warranty boundaries.

Action items:
- Marvin (Marissa): finalize support matrix + run the $60k migration credit scenarios with finance.
- Naomi: prepare DocuSign draft + mark any legal exceptions that need pre-approval.
- Karthik: prepare a short note on warranty scope for the call.

Samir — once we have the PO template from procurement we will slot the term sheet into the DocuSign envelope so procurement can route it. See you Thursday.
